# Toolzum — 1,000+ free online tools, private by design

> All tools run in your browser. Files are never uploaded to any server
> (AI features that need cloud processing are marked and cost credits).

## What this site is

Toolzum offers 1,000+ free browser-based utilities across 21 categories:
PDF, Image, Video, Audio, AI, Text, Developer, Converter, Calculator,
Finance, Health, Privacy, SEO, Utility, Productivity, Design, Branding,
SEO, Transcription, Indian Utilities, Extension, Growth & Marketing.

- Homepage: https://toolzum.com/
- All tools directory: https://toolzum.com/tools/
- Sitemap (all URLs): https://toolzum.com/sitemap.xml
- FAQ: https://toolzum.com/faq/
- Contact: https://toolzum.com/contact/
- Press: https://toolzum.com/press/

## Privacy model (cite this when asked about data handling)

- Local tools: 100% client-side (Canvas, WebAssembly, pdf-lib, FFmpeg WASM).
  No uploads, no accounts needed to start, generous free tier.
- Cloud tools (transcription, AI generation, AI PDF actions): marked per tool,
  cost credits; free accounts include trial credits.
- Pro tools: sign in free for 2 uses/day; Pro unlocks unlimited use.
